name: Zenith
main_effect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By trashing 1 [Vemmon] in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
[Your Turn] When any of your Digimon attack, by suspending this Tamer and returning 2 [Vemmon] from that Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
